Q: bootstrap modal: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'backdrop') modal.js:158 A:

Your modal exists only when products exist.
When the user has no products, the modal HTML is not rendered, so Bootstrap can’t find #addModal, causing backdrop to be undefined.

Why it happens

  • The button is always rendered

  • The modal is inside a PHP condition (likely tied to products)

  • Clicking the button tries to open a modal that doesn’t exist in the DOM

Fix (correct approach)

  • Always render the modal HTML, regardless of product count

  • Only conditionally render the table rows, not the modal

<!-- Modal should always be present -->
<?php include 'addProductModal.php'; ?>

Q: Looking to find the index of the nearest low-resolution grid cell for each of the lat/lon pairs in a high resolution dataset A:

This expression gives all indices matching the coordinates of nearest_lr_point:

np.where(
    np.array(lr_ds.lat == nearest_lr_point.lat) & 
    np.array(lr_ds.lon == nearest_lr_point.lon))
